correctness.rationale: Exact reduced-row-echelon enumeration yields 4 F5 lines and 40 F25 lines in six cells of counts (25,9,4,0,1,1). Exact Groebner quotient dimensions (26,9,4,0,1,1), plus a nontrivial tangent at one big-cell point, prove these are all geometric lines. Full Grassmannian Jacobian ranks are 4 at 36 points and 3 at four coordinate lines; each exceptional m^2 and m^3 local quotient has length 2, and Nakayama gives local dual numbers. Thus total Fano length 44 and Frobenius cycles 1^4,2^18. All critical steps are reproduced by verify.py and verify.stdout.
